# Box QR / 상자QR

> A local-first moving-box log: QR/number sticker, photos, short contents list. Search “Lego” to find which box. Not the Boxes iOS app.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://box-qr.try-dabble.com/
All data stays in the browser (IndexedDB `box-qr`, localStorage key box-qr:boxes:v1). No accounts, no server-side storage, no box/photo cap.

This is NOT Boxes (iOS), Sortly, MoveAdvisor, or a cloud inventory.

## Pages

- [Home](https://box-qr.try-dabble.com/): Add a box with photos + items, search, show/print QR, open a box via `?box=`
- [Privacy](https://box-qr.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://box-qr.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/box-qr): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Add a box with no login
- Optional room/label, contents list (one item per line), unlimited photos
- Search by item text, room, or box number
- Show and print a QR sticker; encoded URL is `/?box=<id>&lang=`
- Opening that URL on this device opens that box
- JSON export/import
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (`?lang=` wins)
- Installable PWA with network-first service worker
